Lettuce:
sheep love lettuce.
if you put any lettuce next to a sheep, he'll eat it.

use lettuce to line a path.

Ghost Costume:
it helps disguise you as a ghost.

to imitate a ghost's bloodcurdling scream,press the $B_ACTION$ button.

Key:
the key is very handy for opening locks...

Ghost vacuum cleaner:
the ideal ghost cleaner...

Inflatable Sheep:
perfect replica of a real sheep.
It acts as a decoy and can be positioned like a live sheep.
You'll have to blow it up yourself,
then jump on it to let the air out!
